acceptance: The page makes no claim that contradicts itself or core develop.
Every specification figure on the page is sourced or removed.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
On `next`, docs/benchmarks/tpc-di.md says the reference tables are smaller than the specification's and lists 'TradeType 6 (5)', which is larger; the FactMarketHistory sentence says 'about two years of trading days times 800 securities gives about 584,800', but 584800 / 800 = 731 calendar days. The specification figures quoted there (about 1,500 brokers per unit, DimDate 1950-2021, 541,550 rows) were not verified.

## Change
Fix the two sentences against core develop and the TPC-DI specification; verify each quoted specification figure against the specification text or remove it.

## Decision gates
None for wording fixes. `next` only; nothing goes to `main`.

## Verification rubric
Pass: each number on the page has a source recorded in the PR body (core file and line, or specification clause); `npm run lint:docs` and `npm run docs:check` pass.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
